description_en: Queries the details of a control policy
description_zh: 调用GetControlPolicy查询管控策略的详情
name: GetControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The language in which the control policy description is returned. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.

This parameter is valid only for system control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en：英文。
ja：日文。

该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language

ControlPolicy.description_en: The details of the control policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of times the control policy is referenced
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

ControlPolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

CONTROL_POLICY: control policy.
RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY: resource control policy
ControlPolicyType.description_zh: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略
ControlPolicyType.title_zh: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was created. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format, in UTC
CreateDate.description_zh: 管控策略创建时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，UTC 时间

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy takes effect for Alibaba Cloud accounts, Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The control policy takes effect only for RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyDocument.description_en: The content of the control policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The Policy Name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.
Custom: custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was last updated. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format, in UTC
UpdateDate.description_zh: 管控策略更新时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，UTC 时间
